newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products end lower as soybeans slide.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products end lower as soybeans slide.

text.p: A drop in soybean futures pressed CBOT soy product futures to a lower close, traders said.
Soymeal was firm relative to soyoil on firm meal cash basis markets and on a rumor China was seeking 80,000 tonnes of optional origin soymeal for September shipment, traders said.
Support also came from prospects for the posting of no deliveries Friday against the September contract. Friday is first notice day for deliveries on the CBOT September contracts.
Soyoil was lower on meal/oil spreading, a sag in soybeans and on ideas for heavy deliveries to be posted Friday against September oil.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 32,000 contracts, up from 24,553 Tuesday, according to the CBOT. Soymeal options volume was estimated at 2,200 contracts, down from 2,320 Tuesday.
Soymeal futures closed $0.20 to $4.50 per ton lower, with September down $0.20 at $262.20. Soyoil futures closed 0.44 to 0.52 cent per lb lower, with September down 0.44 at 25.11.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 18,000 contracts, down from 18,638 Tuesday. Soyoil options volume was estimated at 700 contracts, down from 3,693 Tuesday.
